body: Hello, author. When deploying, I am unable to download the alpasim image and it shows that I do not have permission. Could you please advise on how to resolve this?

comments.body: When you let it run, does it build it automatically?

Thanks for flagging this, that's a bug. 
If you don't mind, could you please check if it works on the branch `dev/migl/make_s3_init_lazy`? This should get rid of the `ALPAMAYO_S3_SECRET` error (you don't need the secret).

The second error (`pull access denied for alpasim-base`) shouldn't be a problem, docker should just build the the image instead (we haven't released the images yet, but building locally should work).
Merged to `main` now, lmk if it still doesn't work!

Thanks for your reply. I tried the `dev/migl/make_s3_init_lazy` code and it works well.

This is a great project. I was wondering whether the code related to scene reconstruction is also open-sourced, or if there are any plans to release it.

Great, closing the issue then. 
Re reconstruction: Can't say, sorry.
